property_summary: For any caller with nonzero credited balance, calling withdrawAll always transfers their credited Ether (reducing c.balance and setting their credit to 0) and completes successfully even if the recipient reverts only when credit is zero — the mutant inverts the guard causing the contract to attempt the send when credit == 0 and thus can revert or behave differently for some inputs (a recipient that records calls and can be set to revert will expose the difference).
change_summary: Replace the conditional if (oCredit > 0) with if (oCredit == 0) to invert the guard, causing different revert/completion behavior for callers with positive credit.
